reason: I already have my Toplux and I reorder it when it runs out, and I forget my vitamins half the time as it is. I'm not going to add two capsules a day from a brand I've never heard of.
objection: Two capsules every day is one more thing I'll forget, and $29.99 is a lot for something I'm not sure I need when I already have a supplement I stick with.
would_change_my_mind: If it were one small capsule or a gummy, and a lot cheaper, like under $15 for the month, I might try one box.
